faults.why: Missing hiragana reading (しろい) for a kanji headword.

faults.quote: The color of snow or milk.
faults.why: Defined as a noun ('the color...'), but 白い is an adjective ('of the color...').

faults.quote: Blank, or having no markings or writing.
faults.why: 白い紙 just means 'white paper' (as opposed to真っ白 for completely blank); this is not a separate sense.
